description: Header file defining the MediaFoundationSourceWrapper class, which implements the IMFMediaSource interface and related media source functionalities for Windows Media Foundation integration in Chromium.

classes.name: MediaFoundationSourceWrapper
classes.description: A class implementing Windows Media Foundation media source interfaces, managing media streams, and handling media events.

methods.name: RuntimeClassInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the media source wrapper with media resource, media log, and task runner.

methods.name: GetCharacteristics
methods.description: Retrieves characteristics of the media source.

methods.name: CreatePresentationDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a presentation descriptor for the media source.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts media playback with specified presentation descriptor and time format.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the media source.

methods.name: GetEvent
methods.description: Retrieves media events.

methods.name: BeginGetEvent
methods.description: Begins asynchronous retrieval of media events.

methods.name: EndGetEvent
methods.description: Completes asynchronous retrieval of media events.

methods.name: QueueEvent
methods.description: Queues a media event.

methods.name: GetInputTrustAuthority
methods.description: Gets trust authority for input streams.

methods.name: GetService
methods.description: Retrieves a service object.

methods.name: GetSlowestRate
methods.description: Gets the slowest supported playback rate.

methods.name: GetFastestRate
methods.description: Gets the fastest supported playback rate.

methods.name: IsRateSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific playback rate is supported.

methods.name: SetRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: GetRate
methods.description: Gets the current playback rate.

methods.name: StreamCount
methods.description: Returns the number of media streams.

methods.name: CheckForEndOfPresentation
methods.description: Checks and sends end of presentation event if needed.

methods.name: HasEncryptedStream
methods.description: Indicates if there are encrypted streams.

methods.name: SetCdmProxy
methods.description: Sets the Content Decryption Module proxy.

methods.name: SetVideoStreamEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables video streams, returning true if re-enabling a stream that reached EOS.

methods.name: FlushStreams
methods.description: Flushes queued buffers from all streams.
